scripts.build:docker: docker run --rm -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e BUNDLE_PATH=/site/vendor/bundle -v "$PWD:/site" -w /site ruby:3.3 bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.serve:docker: docker run --rm -it -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e BUNDLE_PATH=/site/vendor/bundle -p 4000:4000 -v "$PWD:/site" -w /site ruby:3.3 bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000
